translation: At the end of the sacrum it meets Shaoyin, and ascends within the spine. It passes Yaoshu (GV2), (below the twenty-first vertebra) Yangguan (GV3), (below the sixteenth vertebra) Mingmen (GV4), (below the fourteenth vertebra) Xuanshu (GV5), (below the thirteenth vertebra) Jizhong (GV6), (below the eleventh vertebra) Zhongshu (GV7), (below the tenth vertebra) Jinsuo (GV8), (below the ninth vertebra) Zhiyang (GV9), (below the seventh vertebra) Lingtai (GV10), (below the sixth vertebra) Shendao (GV11), (below the fifth vertebra) Shenzhu (GV12), (below the third vertebra) Taodao (GV13), (below Dazhui) Dazhui (GV14), (below the first vertebra) and meets and combines with the Hand and Foot three yang. It ascends to Yamen (GV15), (five fen into the hairline behind the neck) meets Yangwei, and enters to connect the root of the tongue.
